message.content: Yes, Wolfgang Schulz did suggest the band learn and play the song "Viva la Vida" by Coldplay at their next jam session. This suggestion came after he and Li Hua had a discussion about which song to incorporate into their set list for the upcoming Sunday session. Specifically, Wolfgang mentioned that the song was "super popular and the crowd usually loves it" and that it would be "awesome to add to our set." He also noted that the energy of the song would "really elevate our performance" and that it was "a fun one to play on the drums." Li Hua agreed with this suggestion, stating that they should add it to their set list because it would be "epic."
